notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.5.5
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1134053284353671208/1194910872418652160/development_update_-_hotfix_-_0.1.5.5.png?ex=65b21278&is=659f9d78&hm=18ea5e608a73437b39262dd140491705d4a94e425357d761ad2b86d2fec1153b&[/img]



[list]
[*] Fixed AI shooting back when chasing the player

[*] Fixed main Quest 3 flashdrive spawn

[*] Now, max energy drink will boost your stamina recovery for 60 seconds

[*] Fixed a bug where the backpack detached from your hand

[*] Safehouse first entry - 
Before: Change level 60s after grabbing the letter
Now : when grabbing the letter, a message will pop up to press the trigger button; the map changes after being pressed. 
[/list]
